objective: Design paired VH/VL candidates against the human PD-1 ligand-binding region on the paper's humanized IGHV3-23/IGKV1-5 framework (IGHJ4/IGKJ1), and compare candidate evidence with the published anti-PD-1-H965 final design.

paper.title: De novo design of epitope-specific antibodies via a structure-driven computational workflow
paper.supplementary: 41467_2025_67361_MOESM1_ESM.pdf (Tables 6-8: full VH/VL + KD for designed panels)

h965_reference.note: Published final-design comparator; not the design parent; not an input to new design.

pd1_panel_published.note: 10 published PD-1 binders with KD; used only as comparison controls.

target.ecd_residues: 33-150 (IgV domain ~33-134); mature protein lacks signal peptide 1-20
target.structure_origin: PDB 4ZQK chain B (PD-1 33-146 observed, 85-92 disordered, S93 construct substitution vs UniProt C93)
target.ligand_binding_interface: PD-1 residues contacting PD-L1 in 4ZQK (CA<10A): 63-84, 124-134 (approximate; full side-chain contact map in inputs/)

structural_references.PDB_4ZQK: PD-1/PD-L1 complex; source of ligand-binding epitope definition
structural_references.PDB_5GGS: PD-1 + pembrolizumab Fab; independent anti-PD-1 epitope cross-check
structural_references.PDB_5GGR: PD-1 + nivolumab Fab; independent anti-PD-1 epitope cross-check (not downloaded)

constraints_declared.editable_regions: Six CDRs only, paper lengths: H1=7, H2=6, H3 7-18, L1=11, L2=7, L3 9-11 (Chothia per Table 1)
constraints_declared.protected: All eight FR blocks from Table 1, VH/VL pairing per candidate
constraints_declared.controls: H965 and the 9 other published PD-1 designs are comparison controls only; never design inputs
constraints_declared.frozen_before_ranking: Gates and weights (see ranking_policy in metrics.json) frozen before candidate ranking
constraints_declared.liability_policy: No Cys in designed CDRs; framework-inherited liabilities recorded as inherited

methods_selected.primary: rfdiffusion_proteinmpnn (RF-Antibody) target-conditioned CDR design on staged PD-1:framework complex
methods_selected.conservative: AntiBMPNN sequence redesign on the staged complex (CDR masks via 1-based ranges)
methods_selected.complex_plausibility: Boltz2 per-candidate [PD-1, VH, VL] predictions with ipTM/PAE; interface contacts computed locally
methods_selected.properties: Antibody_Prediction (Thermal_Stability_ESM, Solubility_ESM, Antigen_Antibody_binding, CDR_Prediction), scheme imgt

honesty_notes: H965 KD 81.6 nM is measured; nothing computed here is a binding measurement.

Published AUROC 0.76 / enrichment 7.41 / discrimination AUROC 0.95 / AAR 0.317 are paper aggregate benchmarks, not candidate-level evidence; they are reported as published values, never assigned to new candidates.
Individual H965 ipTM/PAE/DockQ values are not published; NEEDS_INPUT for that comparison row.
Structural overlap with the PD-L1 site supports a competition hypothesis only; no functional blockade is demonstrated.
